subject.title: docs(install): add vendor-neutral NVIDIA Jetson install guide

question: Should OpenClaw accept a first-party vendor-neutral Jetson install guide in core docs, and should turnkey hardware references be omitted or routed to ecosystem/vendor surfaces?
rationale: The patch can be mechanically repaired for NVIDIA accuracy, but VISION.md and the earlier closed commercial hardware PR leave the first-party hardware-docs boundary as a maintainer product choice.

options.title: Accept Vendor-Neutral Guide After Repair
options.body: Merge the guide after the NVIDIA setup guidance is corrected and the page stays free of commercial hardware promotion.

options.title: Route Hardware Guidance Outside Core Docs
options.body: Close or pause this PR and keep Jetson or turnkey hardware guidance in vendor or ecosystem docs instead of first-party OpenClaw docs.

options.title: Split Scope Decision From Accuracy Repair
options.body: Let an automated docs repair fix the JetPack guidance now, then require a maintainer review before merge for the core-docs placement decision.

recommendation.title: Accept Vendor-Neutral Guide After Repair
recommendation.body: Merge the guide after the NVIDIA setup guidance is corrected and the page stays free of commercial hardware promotion.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about docs policy and first-party scope, which maps most closely to the current VISION/docs policy history in likelyOwners.
